exhibit c, the real one

for you, nush

One month sounds small when I write it down, but it hasn't felt small at all. It's been teddy bears and handwritten cards, terrible selfies that somehow turned out perfect, and you doodling our names on your wrist like it was the most obvious thing in the world.

I like that you laugh at your own jokes. I like that you hold on tight. I like that "I should take pills for memory" is a full sentence I now associate with you, specifically, and no one else.

Here's to the next one, and the one after that, and however many more it takes before this website needs a serious redesign.

with love, yours,
Yajat Kataria 🐻🩷
